name: combat flow
lore:
In the wild, bloodletting possesses a distinct, predatory rhythm. This "Combat Flow" is no mere exchange of blows; it is a biological imperative, a pulse shared by predator and prey alike. When steel meets hide, the battlefield becomes a fleeting ecosystem governed by instinct.

Observe the wolf’s lunge or the wizard’s incantation; each is a ripple in a greater current. Initiative is the sudden snap of a dry twig, shattering the stillness. The subsequent turns are not isolated moments but a desperate choreography—a cycle of breath, tension, and release. To the uninitiated, it is chaos. To the scholar, it is the natural law of survival made manifest. To master this flow is to cease fighting the tide and instead become the flood. Remember, traveler: in this grim dance, he who loses the tempo invariably feeds the crows.
